worst_flaw: The design applies one flat 30% target to every agent and adds no case-mix or small-book handling. Agents in queues where articles rarely fit, or with very few eligible tickets, get unfair or noisy results. The keep/change/drop decision also uses absolute post-programme rates, so it cannot tell the reward's added value apart from the workflow fixes or seasonal case mix, even with a two-week cohort stagger.
